description: Finance found deposits that are a cent short. Example: a party of 5 at Harborlight Kitchen ($15 per guest) with the 2.5% passholder discount is $73.125, which should round to $73.13 but is charged as $73.12. Deposits must round half up to the cent, using decimal arithmetic rather than floats.

acceptance_criteria.text: Deposits round half up to the cent: 5 guests at $15 with a 2.5% discount is $73.13, and 1 guest at $15 with a 2.5% discount is $14.63.
Deposits that were already exact are unchanged, for example 4 guests at $15 is $60.00.
